notes.title: Women's Day Sale
notes.notes: Woman's Day Sale is here to celebrate all the games made by female led studios and Being a Penguin for sure belongs to this list. Who is behind the game? Well, my name is Susan and I am an indie game developer. I co-founded our tiny 2-person studio called LogLog Games and my goal is to make better and better games.

notes.title: Developer plays Being a Penguin!
notes.notes: Watch the re-stream of how the developer plays and comments the game and answers the questions during the live Next Fest event.

notes.title: Introducing Being a Penguin by the developer
notes.notes:
This is the first time the game is being shown to the public! Prepare for a beautiful experience with some great views. Sit back, relax, and enjoy this beautiful world with an atmospheric perspective! You will be placed in a shoes of Bree, a penguin who doesn't want to be a penguin.
